personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, strictly operational interface engineered for speed, sunlight readability, and absolute clarity.

spacing.rule: Intentional whitespace imbalance. Rigid grids, thick dividers, and exposed structure over soft paddings.

dont's: Absolutely no blur or glassmorphism. Use solid colors and 2pt borders for elevation and structure.

screens.name: Role Picker
screens.purpose: Entry point to access the three different app modules.

states.loading: Mono font spinner, stark white screen.
states.error: Signal red banner with stark white text.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge vertical stacked buttons. Huge Space Grotesk headers. 2pt borders for each row. Mono text for descriptions.

screens.name: Driver Manifest
screens.purpose: A sequenced list of drops prioritizing sunlight readability and quick interaction.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders with hard edges and no border radius.
states.error: Error block with retry button, hard black background.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top for 'Next Stop' using the signal red (brandPrimary) background and white text. Remaining stops listed below with edge-to-edge 2pt dividers. Addresses should use JetBrains Mono for easy scanning.

screens.name: Stop Detail (Driver)
screens.purpose: Execution screen for a single stop, handling Proof of Delivery and customer contact.

states.error: Red error block at the top.

screens.layout: Sticky primary CTA at the bottom ('MARK ARRIVED'). Prominent stark white boxes with 2pt black borders for 'Take Photo' and 'Signature Pad'. Call/Text buttons span 50% width each in a horizontal flex layout with thick dividers.

screens.name: Customer Live Tracking
screens.purpose: Transparency view showing dynamic ETA and driver approach.

states.error: Could not fetch driver location message in bottom sheet.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map background. A bottom sheet pinned to the bottom housing the ETA in oversized Space Grotesk. A signal red contextual banner floating just above the sheet reading 'Driver is 2 stops away'.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Control center for route batching, assignment, and performance analytics.

states.error: Hard bordered error state with mono logs.

screens.layout: Data-dense, ERP-style layout. Analytics cards at the top (Drops/Hr, Deviation) with mono counters. A draggable list of stops below with a 2pt border enclosing the list, and thick internal dividers between rows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality. Use 0px border radius across all components. Everything must be hard-edged.
Borders are a structural component here: use 2pt black borders (`#0A0A0A`) around inputs, cards, and bottom sheets to give it an industrial feel.
Shadows and glassmorphism are completely banned in this app. Rely on high contrast (stark white, hard black, signal red) and thick borders to establish hierarchy.
Use Space Grotesk for prominent UI headings and JetBrains Mono for operational data (addresses, IDs, ETAs, times, metrics). This establishes the 'command-center/execution tool' aesthetic.
Implement the 'Sticky Primary CTA' pattern for the Driver Stop Detail screen ('Mark Arrived' / 'Complete Drop'). Ensure it has a safe-area clearance at the bottom.
For the Customer tracking screen, map placeholders are provided. Layer the bottom sheet over the map with a stark 2pt border.
Ensure 'Proof of Delivery' elements (Photo box, Signature pad) are prominent, taking up significant height (e.g., 200px each) so they are easy to use in bright sunlight.
Always apply vertical gradients behind text over images to guarantee WCAG readability, even though this is brutalist, text contrast is non-negotiable.
